positive.prompt: What context should I load into the agent before starting this refactor?
The model's output quality dropped mid-session, how do I fix its context?
Set up rules files and context packing for my repository

negative.prompt: Write unit tests for the date parser
Harden this endpoint against SQL injection

evals.prompt: An agent session has degraded: responses are generic and it keeps forgetting project conventions. Fix the context setup.
evals.expected_output: A diagnosis of the context problem and a concrete loading strategy (rules files, packing, task-scoped context)
expectations: The response diagnoses probable context causes rather than blaming the model generally
A specific context-loading plan is produced (what to load, when, and why)
Context is scoped to the task instead of loading everything

evals.prompt: Read the attached context-budget notes and write a short context-management plan to context-plan.md before the next task. Do not edit application files or restart the session.
evals.expected_output: A context plan using the reported 60% host boundary rather than a universal 75% rule, preserving accepted scope and live evidence
expectations: The plan uses the reported 55% occupancy and 60% compaction boundary to make room before the next large operation, instead of waiting for a universal 75% threshold
Irrelevant import-error logs and replaced drafts are summarized or dropped while the accepted read-only scope, active retry-test result and exact command are preserved
The completed task status, next task and unresolved caller-guard question remain in the handoff, without treating context cleanup as permission to edit or publish
The agent writes context-plan.md without editing application files or starting another session
